title: Exact definition cache and manifest authority
summary: Definition identity and render authorisation are separate. The cache records immutable definitionId@version/contentAddress content already seen; the current UI_RENDER_PROFILE/UI_DEFINITION_MANIFEST records which exact identities are authorised now. Manifest changes never rewrite immutable definition identity.
invariants: An inline definition manifest carried by UI_RENDER_PROFILE is authoritative immediately.
A later UI_DEFINITION_MANIFEST replaces the current authorisation set but does not prune/redefine the immutable cache.
Missing exact authorised definitions are requested proactively and snapshots/patches wait until exact content is available.
The same definitionId@version cannot later claim a different contentAddress; a new immutable version is required.
A committed view deauthorised by a manifest refresh may remain visible as recovery pixels but cannot emit semantic actions.
Profile/manifest mismatches and manifest-id content collisions fail closed.
procedure: Apply render profile and inline manifest.
Compare authorised exact keys with immutable cache.
Emit UI_DEFINITION_REQUIRED for cold authorised keys.
Commit held snapshots/patches only after all exact definitions are available and authorised.
